GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 700m was eased when racing close to heels. Near the 400m was eased to avoid heels. Unplaced favourite ($3.50). Rider stated it had been her intention to settle in a forward position, however with runners improving to her outside she elected to ease and allow those horses to cross, which resulted in her mount settling further back than intended. She added in her opinion the mare did not handle today’s tight turning track. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormality.
